components.name: Primary action
components.description: Primary browser workspace action; tone changes on hover without movement.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #b9a0ed; border-radius: 8px; background: #b9a0ed; color: #1b1428; font: 600 13px 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #cbb1f4; border-color: #cbb1f4; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7c3f7; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Quiet action
components.css: .ds-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #3b3449; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #f0edf5; font: 600 13px 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-quiet:hover { background: #24202e; border-color: #b9a0ed; color: #fff; } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7c3f7; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-quiet { transition: none; } }

components.name: Public navigation
components.description: Compact text links with tonal hover and visible keyboard focus.
components.html: ProductFormats
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #c4becf; font: 13px/1.65 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #24202e; color: #f0edf5; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7c3f7; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Sample selector
components.description: Selected and unselected sample controls shown together; the panel illustrates state, without recreating React behavior.
components.css: .ds-selector-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; background: #1b1823; border-block-end: 1px solid #3b3449; } .ds-selector { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: #c4becf; font: 500 13px/1.5 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-selector[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #33283f; color: #d7c3f7; } .ds-selector:hover { background: #24202e; color: #f0edf5; } .ds-selector:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7c3f7; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Arabic translation field
components.description: Editable text with direction, associated helper text and visible focus.
components.html: Keep protected tokens unchanged.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { background: #1b1823; padding: 24px 32px; } .ds-field-label { display: block; color: #aca3bb; font: 13px/1.65 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; } .ds-translation { display: block; min-height: 116px; width: calc(100% - 30px); margin: 12px 0; padding: 12px 14px; resize: none; background: #15111b; color: #f0edf5; border: 1px solid #665176; border-radius: 8px; caret-color: #b9a0ed; font: 500 clamp(22px, 2vw, 28px)/1.9 'LH Public Arabic', 'LH Public', sans-serif; } .ds-translation:focus { outline: 2px solid #b9a0ed; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: transparent; } .ds-translation:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7c3f7; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; color: #aca3bb; font: 12px/1.65 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; }

components.name: Format tags
components.description: Passive unboxed format labels; they do not claim selected, hover or focus behavior.
components.html: JSONCSVPO / POT
components.css: .ds-format-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-format-tag { margin-inline-end: 12px; padding: 0; border: 0; color: #d7c3f7; font: 13px/1.65 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; }

components.name: Bilingual proof sheet
components.description: Flat source/translation surface with valid and missing-token examples; controls preserve their real keyboard states.
components.html:
Source text

Hold the line, {player_name}.

✓ {player_name} Kept! {player_name} Missing

✓ Protected tokens preserved
components.css: .ds-proof { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); gap: 14px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #3b3449; border-radius: 12px; background: #1b1823; color: #f0edf5; font-family: 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; } .ds-proof-label { color: #aca3bb; font-size: 13px; } .ds-proof-dialogue { margin: 18px 0 0; font: 500 clamp(22px,2vw,28px)/1.6 'LH Public',sans-serif; } .ds-proof-field { display: block; width: calc(100% - 30px); min-height: 116px; margin: 12px 0; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #665176; border-radius: 8px; resize: none; background: #15111b; color: #f0edf5; caret-color: #b9a0ed; font: 500 clamp(22px,2vw,28px)/1.9 'LH Public Arabic','LH Public',sans-serif; } .ds-proof-reset { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #d7c3f7; cursor: pointer; font: 13px 'LH Public', 'LH Public Arabic', sans-serif; } .ds-proof-field:focus { outline: 2px solid #b9a0ed; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: transparent; } .ds-proof-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7c3f7; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-proof-reset:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d7c3f7; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-proof-tokens { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-proof-token { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #3b3449; border-radius: 6px; color: #bdcfbf; font-size: 12px; } .ds-proof-token code { color: #d7c3f7; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-proof-token[data-missing='true'] { color: #ffc6bd; background: #382027; border-color: #885160; } .ds-proof-status { color: #9cd9b4; align-self: end; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-proof { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 20px; gap: 16px; } }

narrative.overview:
Words are both the work and the identity. The public landing page uses matte ink, restrained violet and readable bilingual typography, with composed multilingual letters as its decorative material. Its character is quiet, direct and spacious: real dialogue, context and protected syntax carry the product proof.

This document records the implemented public landing system owned by `src/public-site.css`, scoped to `#public-site`. It does not define the Web App, Admin, Radio or other routes. Preserve the LocalizationHub name and existing logo, factual copy, existing interactive demonstrations, all tips and secret interactions, and Radio behavior.

The user pinned the picture-free dark/violet direction and requested multilingual background letters. The public composition was amplified on 2026-10-01 and verified locally. Human visual acceptance is still pending, and no publication has occurred. The chosen world is established; that status does not imply approval of the final rendered layout.
keyCharacteristics: Humanist Latin and Arabic reading quality.
Solid, flat proof surfaces and measured separators.
Real editable demonstrations with visible states.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Decorative letters stay subdued behind readable content; violet identifies action and meaning rather than filling every surface.

rules.name: The Script Integrity Rule
rules.body: Do not apply English tracking or line-height to Arabic; preserve text direction and isolate protected syntax when it shares a line with Arabic.

rules.name: The Flat Proof Rule
rules.body: Interactive demonstrations remain steady sheets; hover changes tone and border rather than lifting or tilting the surface.

dos: Do keep the public system scoped to its canonical runtime owner.
Do preserve readable English and Arabic, visible focus and narrow-screen reflow.
Do use real editable dialogue and protected-token states as product proof.
Do keep multilingual decoration deterministic, subdued and noninteractive.
Do preserve factual copy, existing tips, secret interactions and Radio behavior.
donts: Don't add game artwork, photos, gradients or glass to this chosen public landing world.
Don't replace distinct section compositions with repeated card shells.
Don't introduce reveal timing, looping animation or scroll-driven movement into the public reading flow.
Don't propagate these tokens into the Web App, Admin, Radio or other routes.
Don't treat local preview verification as human visual acceptance or publication.
